t: A programmable name badge with a bright color screen and five buttons.
steps: Look for leftover stock at Switch Science or a local reseller, or check the newer Badgeware Tufty.
Get a USB-C data cable or the Accessory Kit with a lanyard and AAA holder.
Install the free Thonny editor on your computer.
Hold the boot button and plug it in to get the RPI-RP2 drive.
Drag the Tufty MicroPython file from Pimoroni onto that drive.
Open Thonny and run a short example from the Tufty examples folder.
Edit the name and colors and save the file to the badge.
Try the QR code and light sensor examples next.
meta: Open Board. From $27. A few stores.
